  2.0.1   2026-09-22  patch        Wired the Label text property to the "Call to Action" text layer on all variants (it existed on the panel but drove nothing, so instance labels could not be set).
  2.0.0   2026-08-25  major   Dropped Context=on-light/on-dark; token-driven via content/default (flips per theme mode). BREAKING vs v1.

A text link that adapts to light and dark automatically — no Context axis, theme-aware via content/default.

## Good to know
Light/dark is automatic — the link binds theme-aware semantic tokens (content/default) that re-resolve from the page/surface variable mode. No Context axis, no -dark variant. Axes are Emphasis (default/subtle), Kind (action/text), and State (default/hover/active/focus).

## Accessibility
Focus state shows a visible focus ring (WCAG 2.2 AA · SC 2.4.7 Focus Visible). Contrast holds in both themes because content/default resolves to a contrasting value per mode (SC 1.4.3 Contrast Minimum).
